turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, Dr. Mehta speaking. I have about five minutes. What is this about?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi Doctor, I'm Sameer from ClinicDesk. We help clinics manage appointments. Before I say anything about us, can I ask how patients book with you today?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: They call the clinic. My receptionist writes it in the diary.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How many calls does she handle in a day?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Around eighty. It's a lot for one person.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And do patients always turn up for their slots?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No. Maybe a quarter don't come. It's a big problem, the chair sits empty.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A quarter is a lot. So two things: your receptionist is flooded with calls, and empty chairs from no-shows. ClinicDesk lets patients book through a WhatsApp link, which takes calls off your receptionist, and it sends WhatsApp reminders a day before and two hours before, which is where clinics usually cut no-shows.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hmm. But my patients are older. They won't use an app.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fair point. There's no app. It's all on WhatsApp, which most of your patients already use. They just reply to a message.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: And the price?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's one thousand four hundred ninety-nine a month.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's too much for a small clinic.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I understand. What does one missed appointment cost you?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Maybe fifteen hundred, two thousand for a cleaning.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So if reminders save you even one no-show a month, it pays for itself. You don't have to take my word for it. There's a fourteen-day free trial, and setup takes one day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay. That's reasonable.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Could I show you a fifteen-minute demo on Thursday at four, and we start the trial the same day?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thursday at four works.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Great, I'll send a WhatsApp confirmation now. Thank you, Doctor.
